name: Tater Brave Local
description: Brave LLM Context web search integration for Tater, geo-targeted and LLM-query-rewritten.

integrations.name: Brave Local
integrations.description: Adds Brave LLM Context Search, geo-targeted to your location (Home Assistant location pre-fills when available), with LLM-rewritten queries and optional spoken-name corrections, as a web search provider for Tater.
